notes: The check compares the outputs at each rising edge (preponed values) with a copy sampled at the preceding falling edge. It is skipped when rst_ni was low at the previous rising edge or at the falling edge, or is low now. The output vector is 159 bits wide; the concatenation adds o_d_valid, which is not in the behavior list but is an output. The 159-bit vector matches the sum of the output widths. The comparison is parameter-independent, so it runs unchanged in all four configurations.
